core_review.label: Core review
core_review.help: These agents shape the main writing quality, argument flow, and scientific clarity of the paper.

research_specific.label: Original research only
research_specific.help: These agents focus on methods and results. They matter most for papers with original experiments or analyses.

evidence_references.label: Evidence, citations, and references
evidence_references.help: These agents verify support for claims, check bibliographic metadata, and clean obvious reference issues.

overall_review_agent.label: Overall Structure & Flow
overall_review_agent.help: High-level review of structure, section balance, argument flow, and major logic issues.

grammar_agent.label: Grammar & Style
grammar_agent.help: Improves grammar, wording, concision, and academic tone. Minor language issues are usually fixed directly as tracked changes.

science_agent.label: Scientific Quality
science_agent.help: Checks scientific precision, overclaims, mechanistic phrasing, and figure-linked scientific interpretation.

literature_review_agent.label: Literature Review Synthesis
literature_review_agent.help: Looks at how well a review paper synthesizes sources, compares studies, and builds a critical narrative instead of only summarizing.

methods_agent.label: Methods Rigor
methods_agent.help: Reviews methods for reproducibility, missing controls, unclear settings, and reporting completeness.

results_agent.label: Results & Interpretation
results_agent.help: Reviews results and discussion for overstatement, weak comparisons, unsupported interpretation, and figure-result consistency.

fact_check_agent.label: Fact Check Against Sources
fact_check_agent.help: Checks whether cited claims are supported by reference metadata, abstracts, and open-access full text when available.

reference_verification.label: Reference Verification
reference_verification.help: Runs deterministic checks for DOI matches, year mismatches, missing metadata, and reference integrity.

citation_style_agent.label: Citation & Reference Cleanup
citation_style_agent.help: Fixes safe citation formatting issues like spacing, OCR artifacts, capitalization, and obvious DOI formatting problems.
